cases.mission: hack.c:cannot_push_msg mounted branch through moverock_core obstructed-destination caller

cases.sourceTrace: A mounted lawful Knight moves a boulder into the west room wall. C moverock_core takes the obstructed-destination else and invokes cannot_push_msg, which names the pony. Worker summary line 2519 denotes the parallel closed-door caller, corrected here to actual obstructed-destination caller line 2444.

cases.title: Automatic farlook descriptions include configured compass coordinates

cases.title: Current key bindings display parameters on custom toggle commands
cases.mission: cmd.c:keylist_putcmds CMD_PARAM row formatting through dokeylist
cases.sourceTrace: C key-list help formats a custom x:toggle(time) binding with quoted time parameter and returns at T:1. JS stores the parameter but explicitly refuses a CMD_PARAM row while constructing key-list output, so the full help screen is missing. This is a formatting/refusal gap, not missing binding parameter storage.
